key_format: (chain: str, address: str); shared chain string eth:mainnet, 42-character ETH address

tracemalloc.note: A separate fresh-process run with tracemalloc enabled hit the RSS safety threshold and exited. The successful full-million baseline uses exact reachable object sizes and uninstrumented RSS, not an extrapolation.

notes: Real 1,000,000-entry Python dictionary constructed in a fresh process, with no SQLite imports or retained database allocation.
Synthetic offline addresses and timestamps; no private keys, blockchain queries, or funding.
Object memory is the sum of sys.getsizeof over all actual distinct reachable dict, tuple, address-string and integer objects. It excludes Python allocator fragmentation and interpreter overhead.
The shared chain string is stored once; each address string, tuple key and epoch integer is distinct.
Only the integer epoch is stored per value: no completeness, finality, provenance, block hashes, transaction hashes, or durable storage.
Lookup key construction is outside each timed interval.
RSS is process peak resident memory and cannot be compared directly to SQLite disk size.
